gen-gf-tektur-gf-voces: Voces stands tall in the lowercase, its hairlines and stems close in weight, never wispy and never heavy. And Tektur above it, with dowel-stiff stems and bent-dowel arcs, gives that sans-serif body a bolder display voice to lean on.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-winky-rough: Winky Rough keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, giving the text a compact, contemporary texture. Tektur's rounded, nib-like strokes do the showing off; the plain sans just carries on.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-winky-sans: Distinctive from the first glance, Tektur draws every character with the plainness of a marker, no swelling at all. Winky Sans answers with capitals barely taller than its lowercase.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-yantramanav: Tektur draws every line at a single unvarying thickness. It makes the headline memorable, while Yantramanav's tall lowercase, huddled close and open at the curve ends, keeps the sans text clean.
gen-gf-tektur-outfit: Strokes like bent pipe cleaner, with curve ends left generously open, give Tektur its oversized, expressive lowercase. Outfit is the gentler neighbor, its cable-like curves finishing early and standing lower.
gen-gf-tektur-plus-jakarta-sans: Tektur brings outsized lowercase and pipe-cleaner strokes with wide openings at every curve end. Plus Jakarta Sans is the precise counterpart, monoline and a notch lower, keeping its curve endings well apart.
gen-gf-tektur-sora: Pipe-cleaner strokes with wide-open curve ends make Tektur unmistakable. Sora brings a precise geometric steadiness beneath it, with no pressure swell at the corners and a lowercase that sits shorter.
gen-gf-tektur-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk reads with counters that breathe, like a hollow reed cut open, each glyph a ribbon of constant width. Over many paragraphs it stays geometric and neutral, while Tektur's taller lowercase sits above it.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-amulya: Loud, tubular, and tilted toward attention, Tilt Neon has a splayed c terminal and a large x-height. Amulya follows in a contemporary plain sans whose generous curve gaps keep a longer stretch of text flowing smoothly.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-plein: Tilt Neon draws a tube-like stroke with no variation in thickness, and its lowercase is large and high. Plein sits lower, a plain sans with clear channels into each round letter.
